data.title: 木更 · 都市恶魔战斗
data.description: 繁华海岛都市的幽暗夜空下，完全恶魔化的木更背后展开漆黑华丽的能量羽翼，手中紧握的妖刀在风中撕裂出凌厉的紫黑剑芒。她侧目回望地面的修，眼中交织着狂热与深情——「修的一切记忆都是属于我的代价！胆敢妨碍我们的人，全部都要在这个夜晚斩成碎屑！」
data.action: 恶魔化形态在都市上空战斗
data.promptProse: With her cursed blade drawn back for a strike and black energy wings spread between the towers, she looks down toward Shu beyond the frame. Violet-black light trails along the blade; neon and fire outline her silhouette.
data.animaCaption: Her cursed blade draws back toward an unseen target, Shu beyond the frame below.
